concerns.text: Tasks T013 and T014 implement a 1M token limit, directly violating Spec FR-001 and Constitution Principle VI which mandate a 10M token 'Micro-Corpus'. The task description admits this overrides the spec without a formal amendment, constituting a silent weakening of a core functional requirement.

Task T025 implements a 5-seed regime (10 models total), violating Spec US-2 and FR-003 which mandate training exactly two models (one AR, one MDM). This scope expansion is not authorized by the spec and risks violating the 6-hour CPU constraint (SC-003) defined in the spec.

Task T033 performs power analysis for the 1M/5-seed regime, whereas Spec FR-009 explicitly requires an a priori power analysis to confirm the 10M token / 100 epoch regime provides sufficient power. The verification step validates a dataset size the spec explicitly forbids.

Task T018 is a meta-task that flags a conflict rather than implementing the spec's requirement. It effectively deprioritizes the Spec's 10M token mandate in favor of the Plan's 1M regime without a formal Spec Amendment, violating the 'Single Source of Truth' principle (Constitution Principle IV).

Task T034 includes a check for SC-002 (|r| ≥ 0.5) but lacks a concrete verification step or pass/fail logic in the deliverable. Spec SC-002 requires measuring the correlation against this threshold; the task description is vague on how this threshold is enforced or reported as a success criterion.

Task T027 logs RAM usage but does not explicitly define the check against the 7GB limit or the failure condition (e.g., 'halt if >7GB'). Spec FR-007 and SC-004 require verifying feasibility within the 7GB constraint; logging alone without a hard constraint check is a weakening of the requirement.
